about: PAT16 of OpenNeuro ds001226 (CC0), two-tensor UKF, the case library's stored result (Contents/data/tractcloud/cases/PAT16.json, 2026-10-01). The regression test (cases.regression.test.ts) reruns the case and compares; a deliberate change that moves these numbers rewrites this file in the same commit, with the reason. Rewritten 2026-10-01 night: the seed's FA computed as the original UKFTractography does for the simple model (the mean of the two minor eigenvalues; ukf.ts), which tracks fewer seeds -- from the same seeds the port now tracks the same seeds as the original (838 fibers each). Rewritten 2026-10-02: whole-brain seeds start only inside the brain (DIPY's median_otsu mask; the head mask put a third of them in the scalp), 16,000 of them (25,000 before; about the same count of streamlines); tracking still runs inside the head mask (median_otsu cuts the top of the brain); and the tracker's constraint projection is exact (the card's too). Judged against the noise floors (agreement.ts), the near-tumor list changed as much as a new seed draw changes it. Rewritten 2026-10-03: the names come from RapidParc (rapidparc/, Ron: Albula switches to it, as Mike Halle's tractline did) instead of TractCloud -- same streamlines (10,828), naming 0.7 s instead of 2.8 s; 27 named tracts near the tumor instead of 30: RapidParc puts more streamlines into the large tracts (thalamo-frontal 196 against 113, inferior longitudinal fasciculus 78 against 31), drops four superficial and two corona radiata/callosal groups TractCloud listed with few streamlines, and adds corpus callosum 6 and the left frontal corona radiata.
